status: COMPLETE / GENERICITY FAILS ON THE REGISTERED TOY POPULATION
evidence_label: MACHINE-VERIFIED exact finite-field census; wall time is COMPUTATIONAL-EVIDENCE
runner_exit_meaning: Expected mathematical CENSUS_FAILED exit because genericity_pass is false; not an instrument or integrity failure.
adjudication: The conjunction of the registered P1-P4 predicates fails in every one of the 24 toy cells: P1_U3 and P1_U4 hold, but P2, P3, and P4 fail. This exhausts the preregistered toy population only.
scope_limit: This does not refute Assumption 1, any Classic McEliece Table-1 cell, or the paper's genericity claim. The toy GF(32), n=8, t=1 population is outside those parameters.

protocol_deviation.description: Frozen C26 removed complete as well as header and t_utc, although the pre-statement permitted removal of only header and t_utc. The frozen control and result are preserved without relabeling.
protocol_deviation.impact: Both parent and successor complete fields are true, and final assembly independently requires complete=true for every successor cell. An additive post-run corrective audit removed only header and t_utc and compared all 14 completed parent-prefix cells, including complete; all 14 were exactly equal. This is post-run validation, not a retroactive pre-production control.
